notes.title: The Mod Update for Sergey - Out Now
notes.content: [p]Thanks to everyone who's been playing GORN 2! We're excited to now introduce The Mod Update for Sergey where you can now fight in all glory with your very own creations. [/p][p][/p][p]While we are incredibly proud to share this update with you, we do so with heavy hearts.[/p][p]During its development, our dear colleague experienced an unimaginable loss — the tragic passing of his beloved son, [b]Sergey[/b].[/p][p]In memory of Sergey, and in solidarity with our teammate and his family, we have named this update in his honor.[/p][p]This tribute is a small gesture to carry his name forward, with love, respect, and remembrance.[/p][p][/p][p]KIODIM IM BEKIRO AL[/p][p]"Forever with your spirit"[/p][p][/p][p]The Mod update will allow for modding on weapons, enemies, levels and creatures. The Mods are accessible through [url="http://mod.io/"]Mod.io[/url] and we have 5 base mods in there right now to showcase what's moddable:[/p][list][*][p]Lightsabre[/p][/*][*][p]A new level. (Blockout textured)[/p][/*][*][p]A new set of armour for the Rokibe[/p][/*][*][p]Swedish midsummer level variation of the Guts level[/p][/*][*][p]Hulk Rokibes (without the superpowers)[/p][/*][/list][p]Enjoy creating and fighting to your heart's content. We can't wait to see what you make![/p][p][/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="d3FPQ8weruA;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3391450/GORN_2/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: BEKIVU Update - Out Now!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=7gspRSspSHU;full][/previewyoutube]

Thank you to all those who’ve been playing GORN 2 so far! We’re excited to unleash the Bekivu update today! 

BEKIVU mode is a variant of endless - here, you never regain health after taking damage. It's hard. Good luck.

We've added random bonus objectives in endless to help deal with the new challenge
[list]
[*] In Custom Mode, you can change settings via the menu IN THE ARENA, and can also SPAWN ANY WEAPON you have unlocked
[*] There are 5 new gold weapons to unlock by reaching certain kill count milestones in BEKIVU mode
[/list]

Also in this patch:
[list]
[*] Increased maximum number of enemies in Custom
[*] Increased maximum number of enemies in Endless
[*] Reduced number of shield-wielding enemies in Endless
[*] Added the tougher glasses-wearing enemies to Endless
[*] Fixed and improved mosquito spawning in Blood Endless
[*] Added more weapon type variety to Flesh, Blood, and Bone Endless,
[*] Improved Endless banner and UI readability
[*] Made arrow damage to the player more fair
[*] Added delays between enemy's Nail Gun fire
[*] Made enemy's Nail Gun aim more accurate so you can block it more reliably
[*] Made slicing even easier
[*] Give you 1 second of invulnerability after a successful parry
[*] You can toggle your grip on and off instead of having to hold down the button
[*] As an EXTRA BONUS the game now runs on 90 Hz on Quest 3
[/list]

So you think our game is too easy? Well taste Bekivu. Satisfaction unguaranteed.
/Love Cortopia

notes.title: GORN 2 - Patch 1.0.2 is now live!
notes.content:
Thanks to everyone who's hopped into GORN 2 so far, we appreciate every one of you for all your support!

Patch 1.0.2 is now up on Steam. We've got quite a few improvements which are all listed below:

[list]
[*] Slightly Increased KO duration
[*] Reduced force required to stun
[*] Increased stunned duration
[*] Reduced stunned stamina
[*] Increased parry VFX size
[*] Increased parried time
[*] Increased parried stamina reduction
[*] Gave Guts 02 enemies easier-to-parry weapons during bonus round
[*] Reduced time required to hypnotize with Hypno Wheel
[*] Increased how long a Rokibe stays hypnotized
[*] Significantly reduced player punch thresholds
[*] Added collision to Spring Board
[*] Made Spring Board trigger bigger
[*] Made Juicer in 04-03 automatically go up and down instead of waiting for trigger
[*] Reduced Juicer bonus round requirement from 5 to 4
[*] Reduced slice thresholds for most weapons
[*] Made some slicing weapons less floppy/twisty
[*] Increased force-add on several blunt weapons
[*] Reduced parry threshold for all weapons
[*] Made sword a little bigger for easier slicing
[*] Made mini axe a little smaller for better control
[*] Made white slice line VFX longer
[*] Made some weapons stickier on slash
[*] Increased thrown weapon speed
[*] Made Morning Star hits feel heavier
[*] Made bruises from Morning Star more severe
[*] Changed fist arrow collider for fewer sideways pushes
[*] Made Rokibe floppier after taking impact damage
[*] Increased Gold Lance speed boost
[*] Reduced force-add on KO blow
[*] Increased punch damage
[*] Increased rock damage
[*] Improved controller angle on Steam
[/list]
